_meta.purpose: Instagram creative matched to Shopify catalog data, for redesign template pages
caveats: Instagram images captured logged-out; some served at reduced resolution (848-1131px wide) rather than the 1080-1440px original upload.
Like/comment counts are as of 2026-07-28 and will drift.
Tobacco Vanilla has NO record in the 56-product catalog - see products.tobacco-vanilla.status.

cross_cutting_findings.bottle_identity_is_consistent: All four products use one bottle: clear glass cylinder, black gloss cap, matte black wraparound label. Label lockup is fixed: 'SIWA FRAGRANCES' (two lines, letterspaced small caps) over the product name, over 'EXTRAIT DE PARFUM'.
cross_cutting_findings.label_typography_is_serif: The product name on every label is set in a SERIF. This contradicts the live site's Poppins-only system and independently validates the serif display direction proposed in Planning/DesignSystem.md.
cross_cutting_findings.concentration_mismatch: Labels read 'EXTRAIT DE PARFUM'. The site's PDP JSON-LD declares category 'Eaux de Parfum'. One of the two is wrong.
cross_cutting_findings.per_fragrance_colour_world: Each fragrance is shot in its own palette - the social feed already behaves like a design system the website does not implement.
cross_cutting_findings.ready_made_notes_module: The Coco Woods post DXH731vCike is a finished top/middle/base notes diagram with circular ingredient thumbnails and hairline leader lines. It is a visual spec for the fragrance-notes metafield proposed in reference-analysis/03-DATA-SCHEMA.md.
cross_cutting_findings.commerce_signal_in_comments: Recurring comments across posts: price requests ('Price?', 'السعر', 'بكام', 'HM'/'Hm' = 'how much'), restock pleas, and 'notes?'. Social carries no price, no notes, no stock state, and no link to the PDP.

products.status_detail: Tobacco Vanilla does NOT exist in the 56-product catalog captured 2026-07-27. No handle, no title, no vendor match. Two other products merely mention tobacco in their notes (male-elixir, carnal-trail) and are unrelated. The product is real - it is photographed with a finished production label - but it is either unpublished, discontinued, or created after the catalog capture. Both Instagram posts predate the capture (Jan/Feb 2026), so 'created later' is ruled out.
products.corroborates: reference-analysis/_CORRECTIONS.md records a 356-review gap between the 1,176 shop-wide Judge.me count and the 820 attributable to published products, implying 27 or more unpublished/deleted products. Tobacco Vanilla is a concrete instance.
products.action_required: Confirm with the client whether Tobacco Vanilla is live, seasonal, discontinued, or pending relaunch, and supply its pricing, sizes and stock before it can be built as a template page.
